summary: This is an 8-K filing by Alaunos Therapeutics reporting preclinical animal-study results for its metabolic candidate ALN1003. No merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or any other special-situation corporate event is described. The filing merely disseminates a press release and investor presentation regarding non-clinical statistical analyses. Because the content is purely a routine scientific update with no deal activity or corporate governance change, it does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
